mainEntity.name: How long does a typical room expansion project take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a room expansion project can range from several weeks to a few months, depending on its complexity, the necessary permits, and material availability. Projects involving extensive demolition, new framing, or custom finishes will naturally take longer. For example, expanding a kitchen or bathroom often takes more time due to plumbing and electrical work. We provide a detailed project schedule outlining key milestones and estimated completion dates after the design phase is finalized.
acceptedAnswer.description: Room expansion projects typically take several weeks to a few months, influenced by complexity, permits, and material availability. Detailed schedules are provided after design.
